core_claims.claim: National Polygon Service contains three linked datasets.
National Polygon provides indicative boundary shape and position.
Title Descriptor provides legal interests and class of title.
Title Number and UPRN Look Up supplies title-number to UPRN associations.
The three datasets are licensed and chargeable.
Sample data can be accessed separately from the full licensed data.
National Polygon covers registered freehold and leasehold titles.
A title can be represented by more than one polygon.
Boundary geometry is indicative rather than a legal survey measurement.
Title Descriptor labels freehold and leasehold interests.
Title Descriptor includes class-of-title information.
Title Descriptor includes estates and interests information.
The lookup dataset uses HM Land Registry title numbers.
The lookup dataset uses Ordnance Survey AddressBase UPRNs.
A UPRN is a persistent property or land identifier.
UPRN matching enables linkage with other public-sector datasets.
Not every title is guaranteed to have a matched UPRN.
Title number remains the Land Registry reference for registered land.
The lookup dataset is closely linked to National Polygon.
The lookup dataset is closely linked to Title Descriptor.
Full NPS access requires the land and property data service.
Exact candidate GML bytes are absent in the current runtime evidence.
Exact candidate INSPIRE identifiers remain unresolved.
A public documentation readback cannot substitute for licensed target bytes.
Indicative polygons cannot be promoted to surveyed legal boundaries.
Title plans use title numbers as unique registry references.
Candidate binding requires a verified title and polygon relationship.
Candidate binding also requires an authoritative UPRN or equivalent identity link.
No synthetic title-to-UPRN relationship is permitted.
NPS data alone does not supply measured terrain elevation.
